epoch_3_cycle_3_outcome.kill_reason: Expanded Stage B completed 80 paired episodes per policy with active mechanism and zero exceptions; PSE full reached 50/80 while bright-single reached 51/80, and the paired upper confidence bound for full minus bright-single was 0.075, excluding the preregistered useful +0.10 prototype improvement.

epoch_4_cycle_1_outcome.kill_reason: Stage 2B completed 40 paired episodes per key policy with zero exceptions. Full RCV improved over queued SmolVLA and the SV-deviation proxy, but lost to the no-context ablation and stateless first-action baseline at 20/40 versus 24/40 each. The claimed current-state queued-vs-fresh validity mechanism is explained by simpler replanning or no-context thresholding.

epoch_4_cycle_2_outcome.archive_reason: Expanded Stage 2B completed 58 paired episodes per key policy with zero exceptions. Full CAVM numerically beat every baseline and the no-contrast ablation, but the strongest-baseline gain was only 1/58 success with paired delta 0.017241 and CI [-0.068966, 0.103448], below the preregistered useful-improvement criterion after the only allowed expansion.

epoch_4_cycle_3_outcome.kill_reason: Stage B completed 40 paired episodes per policy with zero exceptions. Full FANG reached 11/40 while base SmolVLA reached 16/40, AFIL proxy reached 15/40, nearest-success replay reached 14/40, and the no-failure ablation also reached 11/40. The failure-aware guidance component did not beat Base, the closest-prior proxy, or the key ablation, so the result is a valid kill under the preregistered Stage B gate.

epoch_4_cycle_4_outcome.hard_stop_reason: The transition model improved strongly over a constant predictor but improved only 0.024689 over an actionless model, below the preregistered 0.05 action-input improvement threshold. This means the proposed action-conditioned state mechanism is not sufficiently supported for rollout.
epoch_4_cycle_4_outcome.archive_reason: Pre-rollout Stage 0 design failure under the frozen audit; do not lower the threshold or launch closed-loop EvoState.
